mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of observations when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% (UNRATE) indicates economic slowdown, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 3.5%) signals an imminent recession, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 AND UNRATE > 3.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1400 during late-cycle expansion periods over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll growth exceeding 0.5% (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential mortgage credit (RSAFS > 700,000 million) indicates strong housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when RSAFS > 700,000 million over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 300 (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent high inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300 over a 5-year rolling window.
